subject: Eval / Procurement acceptance cadence and sequencing
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@novaya.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jane Liu <jane.liu@novaya.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novaya.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP and a proposed gating sequence for MSA/DPA/order form

Laura —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We had an internal sync this morning and procurement/legal want a clear mutual action plan that ties the evaluation milestones to contract gating: specifically how the MSA/DPA and order form align with acceptance testing and data handling checks.

Attached is a quick internal sketch (for your reference) of the evaluation track and the items procurement flagged:
- evidence of SOC2-in-scope controls
- data residency/retention confirmation
- sample SLA language on availability and support windows

Can your team propose the sequence you recommend so we can share it with our legal? We want to avoid late-stage redlines that push the go-live. Ideally we lock MSA terms concurrently with the pilot acceptance criteria, then finalize order form pricing after the pilot success sign-off.

Target timelines: pilot start w/c Nov 29, acceptance window 2 weeks, target procurement sign-off by Dec 20 if possible. These are aggressive but aim to keep our Q1 deployment.

Thanks — if easier, loop in your legal / procurement folks and we can do a short call.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Digital Platform
Novaya Health
[Attachment: internal-eval-sketch.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novaya.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jane Liu <jane.liu@novaya.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novaya.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and a proposed gating sequence for MSA/DPA/order form

Samir — thanks for the clear asks and the timeline. I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP-Novaya-v0.1.pdf) plus a compact acceptance-criteria matrix. High level thoughts:

- We can run the pilot starting week of Nov 29 as requested; we'll need a finalized pilot scope by Nov 22 to provision dedicated capacity and run the data ingestion tests.
- Proposed sequencing (recommended):
  1) MAP + pilot scope sign-off (operational owners) — Nov 22
  2) MSA redline window starts (legal teams) — Nov 23 to Dec 7 (concurrent with pilot execution)
  3) Pilot acceptance testing — Dec 6–Dec 17 (2-week window + remediation week)
  4) DPA review and signatures — Dec 8–Dec 20 (overlaps; DPA items that affect acceptance flagged early)
  5) Order form (final pricing/commits) — Dec 21–Dec 24 (contingent on acceptance)

Notes/risks: if procurement requires SOC2 Type II evidence prior to the DPA, that can add a 2–3 week hold. We can provide a SOC2 snapshot (attached) and offer a contractual remediation SLA if you need it sooner. Also: if you want a limited data residency commitment for the pilot, call that out in the MAP by Nov 18 so we can route accordingly.

Action items:
- Samir: confirm pilot scope doc by EOD Nov 18
- Jane: please share any non-negotiable DPA clauses we should be aware of before Nov 20
- Karthik/Vanessa: Laura asked you to weigh in on the MSA redline cadence below.

I’ll also add this plan to the HubSpot deal record and create a short shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
[Attachment: MAP-Novaya-v0.1.pdf (PDF)] [Attachment: Acceptance-criteria-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)]
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2345678

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@novaya.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jane Liu <jane.liu@novaya.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novaya.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and a proposed gating sequence for MSA/DPA/order form

Looping in legal sequencing: quick notes from our side (legal/pricing):

1) MSA redlines: we can commit to a 10-business-day review cycle provided we get a single consolidated redline doc from Novaya legal. Multiple separate comment threads create delays. Recommend Novaya appoint a primary negotiator and deliver redlines by Nov 23.

2) DPA: if you require changes to technical controls beyond our standard template (e.g., additional retention controls), flag them now. For most customers we can accept contract-side commitments plus an operational runbook. If Novaya insists on template-level DPA edits, that should be scoped as an exception and may require our security review (3–5 business days).

3) Order Form / Pricing: pricing hold windows — to preserve the Q4 pilot pricing, we need an LOE (letter of intent) or purchase order by Dec 20; otherwise standard renewal/pricing cadence applies. If Novaya needs a multi-year commit to get price protection, let's discuss the order form draft early.

4) Evidence: Attaching our SOC2 snapshot. If procurement requires an on-site audit or additional attestations, coordinate that request by Nov 19.

Recommended change to sequencing: allow MSA and DPA discussions to run in parallel with pilot execution, but require a sign-off gate for production data access prior to go-live.

I’ll be available for a short legal alignment call Tue Nov 16 or Wed Nov 17.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.com]
[Attachment: SOC2-Snapshot-2026.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novaya.com>, Jane Liu <jane.liu@novaya.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novaya.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and a proposed gating sequence for MSA/DPA/order form — alignment and next steps

Samir / Jane / procurement — thanks, all. Quick alignment note after reviewing Karthik’s points and our internal capacity schedule. Confirming the MAP milestones and owners below (this will be the canonical plan we link to the deal record):

MAP milestones (canonical):
- Nov 18: Pilot scope doc (owner: Novaya — Samir / Jane)
- Nov 22: Redwood provisions pilot capacity (owner: Redwood infra — Vanessa)
- Nov 23: Novaya legal delivers consolidated MSA redlines (owner: Novaya legal)
- Nov 23–Dec 7: Concurrent MSA redline review (owner: Redwood legal — Karthik)
- Dec 6–Dec 17: Pilot acceptance testing window (owner: Novaya product)
- Dec 8–Dec 20: DPA review & signatures (owner: joint; flag blockers by Dec 10)
- Dec 21–Dec 24: Order form finalization & PO/LOI (owner: Novaya procurement)

Minimum requirements to avoid procurement delay: either (A) consolidated MSA redline by Nov 23 and LOI/PO by Dec 20, or (B) if you need additional DPA edits, identify them no later than Nov 20 so we can scope security review.

Next steps / asks:
- Samir: please drop the pilot scope doc into the shared Drive folder by EOD Nov 18. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP
- Jane: confirm who will be the single legal negotiator for consolidated redlines (name + email) by Nov 18.
- Procurement: if you need further compliance artifacts beyond SOC2 snapshot, list them now (we can queue a short operations review).

I’ve added the MAP pdf to the HubSpot record and created a short checklist in the shared Drive (see Acceptance-criteria-matrix.xlsx). Once we have the consolidated MSA redlines we’ll schedule a 30-minute legal touchpoint to close open items.

If everyone is aligned I’ll send a short calendar hold for Dec 8 to review DPA sign-off status.

Thanks, looking forward to a smooth pilot.

Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
[Attachments: MAP-Novaya-v0.1.pdf, Acceptance-criteria-matrix.xlsx, SOC2-Snapshot-2026.pdf]
